subcategory_text: Run security tests (SAST, DAST, SCA, IAST, pentest) across the lifecycle and integrate results with defect management.
implementation_examples: L1: SAST and SCA in CI
L2: DAST and targeted pentest on staging
L3: Continuous testing with risk-based depth
assessment_objectives: Determine whether automated security tests run in CI.
Determine whether pen tests occur at defined milestones.
